# Rough.js 4.6.6 (vendored)

`rough.cjs.js` is the unmodified `bundled/rough.cjs.js` from the npm package `roughjs@4.6.6`
(https://github.com/rough-stuff/rough, MIT, see LICENSE). No dependencies.

sha256 f10ad1eacdb19b1a837ad311f80de596ef206046247a3fae9951d8f2adc59e36

Used only by `tools/rough_paths.js`, which turns shapes into hand-drawn SVG paths
offline. Nothing is fetched at render time.
